stem: What sentence supports the idea that joining a book club could help someone make friends?

options.label: A
options.text: Today more young people are forming their own book clubs. (paragraph 1)

options.label: B
options.text: In many book clubs, each member takes a turn selecting the book for the group to read. (paragraph 4)

options.label: C
options.text: In many ways, book clubs allow their members to think about new ideas. (paragraph 4)

options.label: D
options.text: By spending time with them at book-club meetings, you will get to know all the members better. (paragraph 6)
